password.title: Password
password.lead: Set the local administrator password. The service stays bound to loopback by default.

pairing.title: Client
pairing.lead: Pair the desktop capture agent or the browser extension so links reach rDownloader automatically.

storage.title: Storage
storage.lead: Downloads need a target directory. Add at least one storage root to continue.

mcp.title: API & MCP
mcp.lead: Optionally create an API token for an external client or register the built-in MCP server with your AI assistant.

services.title: Accounts
services.lead: Add hoster accounts and Usenet servers. You can skip this and add them later in the settings.

password.configured_hint: The administrator password is set. Change it any time under Settings → General.

pairing.intro: Pairing is optional — you can always add links by hand. A paired client sends captured links, Click'n'Load and .nzb files straight to the queue.

storage.intro: A storage root is the base directory downloads are written to. Paths must be absolute and are created if they do not exist yet — in a container, only a path on a mounted volume survives being recreated.
storage.default_category_hint: A default category named "Downloads" is created for the first storage root so the queue has a destination.
storage.required_hint: Add at least one storage root — without it no download can start.

services.intro: Optional: premium hoster accounts lift speed and captcha limits, a Usenet server enables NZB downloads.
